title: Double-Entry Accounting Ledger System
learningObjectives: Model immutable Journal Entries with balanced Debits and Credits
Enforce atomic balance constraints across multiple asset, liability, and equity accounts
Design append-only ledger tables with cryptographic hash chaining (auditability)
keyTradeoffs: Real-time account balance calculation vs cached running balance tables
Strict database serializable isolation vs optimistic concurrency locking
commonPitfalls: Using floating-point numbers instead of integer minor units (cents) or fixed-point decimals
Allowing UPDATE or DELETE operations on ledger transaction rows
transferPrompt: How do ledger entries record reversals and chargebacks while preserving immutable transaction history?
